summary: Verified iteration 15's additive diagnostic improvement to the broadcast feature: categorized failure reasons (error_counts). Backend: 4/4 pytest tests passed -- text-only broadcast and media(image)-attached broadcast both confirmed the invariant sent+failed==total AND sum(error_counts.values())==failed; error_counts keys restricted to known labels (blocked_bot, invalid_chat, rate_limited, network_timeout, other); auth enforced (401) on both POST /api/admin/broadcast and GET /api/admin/broadcast/latest without a token. Frontend: unlocked panel with PIN 246810, sent a real broadcast to the 58 preview users via UI, confirmed broadcast-status text transitioned 'queued -> sending to 58 users now' then polled to 'done — sent 41/58 — 17 failed (16 blocked the bot, 1 chat not found)' -- friendly labels used (not raw codes like blocked_bot/invalid_chat), parenthetical breakdown sums exactly to the failed count (16+1=17). Regression: status transitioned running->done correctly via polling and stopped once done (consistent with iter14's verified resumable job system); error_counts field addition did not break anything.
critical_code_review_comments: _send_to_user()'s categorization (Forbidden->blocked_bot, BadRequest->invalid_chat, RetryAfter-after-retry->rate_limited, TimedOut/NetworkError->network_timeout, else->other) is correctly ordered (specific exceptions before generic Exception) and matches python-telegram-bot's exception hierarchy.

run_broadcast_job's batch $inc of error_counts.{cat} via Counter is correct and atomic per-batch; the first-upload path also correctly $inc's error_counts.other on failure (verified with a live media broadcast in this iteration).

Frontend describeErrors() correctly filters zero-count entries and falls back to the raw key if a label is somehow missing (defensive, good). ERROR_LABELS mapping matches backend's 5 categories exactly.
No bugs found. This is a clean, small, additive change consistent with the problem statement's diagnosability goal.
seed_data_creation: 2 additional TEST_-prefixed broadcasts sent to the ~58 real preview test users during pytest (1 text-only, 1 with a tiny generated PNG) + 1 more via Playwright UI flow, consistent with prior iterations' allowance.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 15's error_counts diagnostic feature is fully verified end-to-end (backend invariant + frontend friendly labels) for both text-only and media-attached broadcasts. No bugs found. bot_users still contains stale/fake test user_ids from earlier iterations that will always show as failed sends (blocked_bot/invalid_chat) -- this is expected pre-existing test noise, not a new issue; sent+failed==total (and now sum(error_counts)==failed) remain the correct invariants to check, not failed==0.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A -- no bugs found this iteration; the original problem (failure reason only in ephemeral logs) is resolved by this categorized error_counts field + friendly frontend breakdown.
